About the community

Building the conversation around quality.

QA Connect Africa exists to bring the people behind exceptional customer experiences into one connected professional community.

We create spaces for QA and customer experience professionals to exchange practical ideas, learn from industry leaders, build meaningful connections, and stay ahead of the changes reshaping contact centre quality.

From emerging technologies to better quality practices, our conversations are designed to move beyond theory and help professionals think about what comes next.

The people behind the community

The minds behind QA Connect Africa.

Meet the people shaping the vision, strategy and community behind QA Connect Africa.

Jecinta Nnenna Onyewuenyi

Founder & Managing Director, QA Connect Africa

Jecinta Nnenna Onyewuenyi is a quality assurance and customer experience professional passionate about building high-performing teams and improving service quality. With experience spanning quality management, training, coaching and business operations, she is committed to helping organisations turn customer interactions into actionable insights that drive continuous improvement. She founded QA Connect Africa to create a professional community where contact centre and quality professionals across Africa can connect, learn and grow.

Umoh Etido

He brings together data-driven thinking, digital strategy and creative problem-solving to turn insights into practical business outcomes. At QA Connect Africa, he leads strategy and marketing, shaping the organisation's digital presence, communications and growth initiatives.
